**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/04/26 (Wed) 06:43
- [FACT] The user is inquiring about a vehicle service shop that specializes in oil changes.
- [FACT] An oil change takes an average of 15 minutes to be completed at this shop.
- [FACT] The shop can work on two vehicles at a time.
- [EVENT] The user presents a scenario involving multiple customers waiting for oil changes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For the 3rd customer, the assistant stated they would have to wait approximately 30 minutes for their oil change when two vehicles are queued.
- [USER] The user inquired what the wait time would be for the 3rd customer if the shop could work on two vehicles at a time.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that for the 3rd customer, they would have to wait approximately 15 minutes for their oil change if two vehicles could be worked on at a time.
- [USER] The user asked what the wait time would be for a 4th customer under the same conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant indicated that the 4th customer would have to wait approximately 15 minutes for their oil change.
- [USER] The user inquired about the wait time for a 5th customer.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant responded that the 5th customer would have to wait approximately 30 minutes for their oil change if the 3rd and 4th customers were added to the queue.
